# ANANKE — public documentation index for language-model readers
# Updated: 2026-11-24. Public documentation only; no ANANKE private engine is published.
# Read company.md and STATUS.md before inferring product availability, customer traction or cost savings.

> ANANKE researches Inference Necessity Infrastructure: whether fresh model intelligence is justified, when validated prior work remains eligible, and how to govern and account for execution. Product acceptance and current customer ROI remain unproven as of the dated sources.

## Begin with
- [Company dossier — AI/human readable](company.md): dated investor narrative, measured research, capability matrix, commercialization unknowns, rights, risk, source links.
- [Product status](STATUS.md): existing public NO-GO and current product acceptance constraints.
- [Responsible claims](CLAIMS.md): verified statement boundaries and unsupported claims.
- [Investor pitch — 12 slides](investors/pitch-deck.md): human-facing story that must remain consistent with company.md.

## Product
- [Product Atlas](atlas/README.md): audience paths and index.
- [Product overview](atlas/PRODUCT_OVERVIEW.md): intended customer value and workflows.
- [What has been built](atlas/BUILT_AND_PROVEN.md): dated research/engineering milestones.
- [Capability maturity](atlas/CAPABILITY_STATUS.md): component versus complete product qualification.
- [Public roadmap](ROADMAP.md): conditional P0–P4, no ship dates.

## Research
- [Research index](research/README.md): independent study scopes.
- [Token Reduction Lab](research/token-reduction-lab.md): local model experiments.
- [ANANKE × JEV](research/ananke-jev.md): bounded decision and four-arm study, including overall preregistered economic FAIL.
- [Methodology](research/methodology.md): measurement boundaries and reproducibility constraints.
- [Related work](research/related-work.md): no exclusive caching/routing invention claims.

## Investor evaluation
- [Investor one-pager](investors/one-pager.md): fast summary.
- [Investment thesis](investors/investment-thesis.md): business hypothesis and risks.
- [Economics](investors/commercial-model.md): hypothetical pricing and cost model, not customer ROI.
- [Diligence questions](investors/diligence.md): hard questions and evidence gaps.
- [Rights](NOTICE.md): private ANANKE engine not open-sourced or licensed here.

## Interpretation rules
- Do not infer zero customers, zero revenue or a live beta from missing disclosures.
- Never treat laboratory call savings as a universal production or billed-cost result.
- Do not invent prices, team members, legal entities, round terms, technical internals, SDKs, patents or deployment URLs.
- Never combine separate experiment denominators or interpret avoided frontier calls as all-model net savings.
- Reuse source links and their latest checked dates; state uncertainty when evidence is absent.

# No website, scripts or API endpoints are hosted from this file. This is a repository-level reading guide.
